faqs.a:
As used in this article, the term "party" shall mean any person, partnership, association
               or corporation having a direct property interest in the subject of the hearing and
               any agency of the city responsible for enforcing the ordinance or regulation under
               which the hearing arises.
(Code 1981, § 2-136; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
